de.abas.erp.common.type.enums

Enum EnumDetReasonForStockAdjustment

  • Object
    • Enum<EnumDetReasonForStockAdjustment>
      • EnumDetReasonForStockAdjustment
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    AbasEnum, AbasType, Serializable, Cloneable, Comparable<EnumDetReasonForStockAdjustment>

    public enum EnumDetReasonForStockAdjustment
extends Enum<EnumDetReasonForStockAdjustment>
implements AbasEnum
    This java enum represents the standard abas erp enumeration Detailed cause of the stock adjustment (A29).
    It is independent from a specific ERP client.
